# XK Trading Floor

> XK Trading Floor (xktradingfloor.com) is a trading community and review platform. It helps traders compare forex brokers, prop firms and crypto platforms, read reviews from real traders, find verified traders, follow live spreads and prop-firm payouts, and discover trading events worldwide.

Key facts:
- Reviews are written by traders who use the companies; anyone can add one after signing in.
- Verified Trader badges are awarded after an application, document check and a call with the XK team.
- Trading education happens in the XK Discord community rather than a separate academy (see /learn).
- The prop firm payout tracker currently shows sample data, labelled as such, until real verified payouts are recorded.
- Content is for information only and is not financial advice.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/): overview, top-rated brokers and prop firms, upcoming events
- [Company reviews](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/reviews): all reviewed brokers, prop firms and crypto platforms
- [Broker reviews](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/reviews/broker)
- [Prop firm reviews](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/reviews/propfirm)
- [Crypto platform reviews](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/reviews/crypto)
- [Verified traders](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/reviews/traders): traders whose track record XK has verified
- [Live spreads](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/live-spreads): broker spread comparison
- [Prop firm payout tracker](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/payouts)
- [Trading events](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/events): expos, conferences, webinars and meetups
- [Blog](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/blog): market analysis, broker and prop firm news, trading guides
- [Learn trading](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/learn): join the XK Discord community, plus the blog's trading guides
- [For brands](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/services): listing and partnership options for brokers and prop firms
- [About](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/about)
- [Contact](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/contact)

## Blog categories
- [Markets](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/blog/category/markets): gold, silver, forex, crypto, stocks, commodities and what moves them
- [Companies](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/blog/category/companies): broker and prop firm reviews, comparisons, platforms and tools
- [Traders & Influencers](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/blog/category/traders-influencers): interviews, trading journeys and the people behind the trades
- [Breaking & Industry News](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/blog/category/breaking-industry-news): prop firm and broker news, regulation and industry changes
- [Learn Trading](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/blog/category/learn-trading): guides, rules explained and lessons for every level
- [Promotions & Deals](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/blog/category/promotions-deals): discounts, challenge offers and broker promotions
- [Countries & Regions](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/blog/category/countries-regions): trading by country: brokers, prop firms, rules and outlooks
- [Events](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/blog/category/events): expos, conferences, webinars and meetups worldwide
- [Tools & Guides](https://stackified.github.io/xktradingfloor/blog/category/tools-guides): calculators, checklists and how-to guides
